name: ArenaPinCharacters
description: Which characters a pin input's cells accept, and which keypad a phone shows for them. `numeric` takes the digits 0 to 9 and asks for the number pad; `alphanumeric` takes the Latin letters and digits, as typed, and asks for the full keyboard. A character outside the set is refused before it reaches a cell, so the code a pin input reports never holds one. The choice is a member rather than a class, because it changes what the cells accept, not how they are drawn.
